title: A splitting mixed finite element method for a stochastic Keller-Segel system with multiplicative noise
summary: In this paper, we propose and analyze a splitting mixed finite element method for a stochastic Keller--Segel system with logistic growth driven by multiplicative noise. By introducing an auxiliary variable representing the chemical gradient together with a time-lagged splitting strategy, the proposed method decouples the original coupled system into a sequence of simpler subproblems.
